releaseNotes:
• Play Store & Indus Appstore Compliance: Added prominent pre-permission SMS disclosure & optional Manual/Gmail-only mode.
• Reduced Sensitive Permission Footprint: Removed unused Notification Listener service from AndroidManifest.xml.
• Zero Data Loss Across Updates: Fixed SQLCipher native loading, WAL checkpointing, schema version preservation, and automated orphaned DB recovery.
• Bill Reminders & Daily Spend Alerts: Runtime Android 13+ notification permissions and offline daytime reminder worker.
